rootCause: PoE fixtures can pass PCB DRC/ERC while still lacking real IEEE compliance, isolation, magnetics, and sourcing verification. Treating PCB cleanliness as PoE compliance would be a dangerous false claim.
fixSummary: Model PoE fixture depth with explicit honesty statuses: electrical fixture only, compliance not verified, magnetics not verified, isolation not certified, sourcing not API verified. Export PCB manufacturing only when DRC/ERC are clean and keep compliance as a separate engineering-review gate.
